quote.basis: current quote supplied by owning operator; not invoice or newly queried provider receipt

fixed_dose.fresh_condition: only qualifying trajectories before KEEP/capability promotion; no fresh exposure in training, G-Pre or timing

measured_frozen_checkpoint0_projection.domain: Projection from exact raw per-family means for the registered 16384:20 mix; not measured training or all-in cost.

later_occupancy_and_coordinate_extra.basis: 50–100% additional frozen proposal projection; an explicit planning assumption, not an empirical bound. Q4 timing was waived.

twenty_dev_evaluations.basis: 15–30 minutes proposed. The observed 165-second six-init/evaluation envelope is context, not a per-DEV bound.

qualifying_fresh.basis: Zero if no trajectory qualifies; up to five minutes proposed across qualifying fresh evaluations. Not measured.

fault_preservation_review_idle.authority: No automatic paid/model retry; preserve faults and obtain the existing external review and any distinct release.

rounded_remaining_request.healthy_run_policy: Renew healthy work; a planning estimate is not a kill deadline. Owner limits, disk constraints and failure rules remain.

already_accrued_episode_cost.includes: All same-resource setup, failed builds, controls, timing, idle, transfer and custody through cutoff; not GPU-active time.
already_accrued_episode_cost.continued_lease_time: Accrues after this cutoff separately; do not sum overlapping cutoffs.

authority.qualification_acceptor: Claude alone after sealed receipt digests
authority.training_dispatch: owner release and genuine current machine/admission transport remain separate; this skeleton grants none

fresh_descriptor.novelty_scope: held out current discrete TRAIN/DEV; historically used pre-D32; different chat-source distribution; no semantic/paraphrase contamination guarantee
